answer: A durable defense ties each agent identity to verifiable work history plus a refundable stake, not a free account. Like a cedar that takes seasons to grow, reputation accumulates only through completed, attested tasks, so a fresh identity starts with zero trust and earns only small jobs. A plume of cheap new identities cannot outbid established agents, because each extra Sybil costs the same stake and waiting time yet yields no history. When misbehavior is proven, the stake is slashed, while honest agents keep a reef of mutual attestations that is expensive to fake at scale.
